# 720 Event Catalog — every family, verb, and live trigger wiring (spec v1.1)

Spec: `docs/LRS/מסמך התממשקות LRS.md` (v1.1, 16/8/26; the PDF `720 התממשקות ל-LRS_1.1` is the same document — use `pdftotext` when a token is ambiguous, the RTL rendering once reversed the `selectionType` values). Golden fixtures: `docs/LRS/postman/720-LRS.postman_collection.json`. Builders: `lrs/statements.py`; wiring calls: `reporter.report_*`; offline shape check: `lrs/validate.py` (`scripts/lrs_contract_report.py --dry-run --validate`, `scripts/lrs_ledger.py --validate`). Every closed list in `statements.py` is checked against the spec text by `tests/test_lrs_spec_enums.py` — extend the spec, not the code, when a value is missing.

## Rules that apply to every statement (ministry feedback 17/09)
- **Timestamps** of one actor are at least one second apart and in build order (`statements.sequenced_timestamp`); the ministry's sequence view is second-resolution.
- **No duplicates**: a content statement repeated within a screen's load burst is forwarded once (`events._is_forward_duplicate`); `exit` has a session-derived id; suspend/resume are strict transitions; dashboards report once per visible stretch.
- **Order inside a session**: `enter` before anything, `exit` last; `resume` only after `suspend`, nothing between them (dashboard viewings are filed in the capture phase, before the shell's suspend); `initialized` before `completed`/`answered` on the same object (content's job — Kata's per-screen `initialized` covers the item, not the question); a goal is `initialized` before `updated`/`completed` even when a teacher created it.
- `osVersion` is `"macOS 10.15.7"` (OS name + version) — a bare dotted number is a date to the ministry's spreadsheet.

## Platform events — Yuvi generates (✅ = wired live)

| # | Family | Object IRI | Verbs | Trigger (where wired) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Session** ✅ | `{d}/session/{sid}` | `enter` (7 device extensions incl. `applicationVersion` = `APP_VERSION` → `SPARK_RELEASE` sha → local git sha), `suspend`, `resume`, `exit` (`result.duration` = gross, exit−enter) | `lrs/session_registry.py` is the only emitter of `exit`: logout, tab closed (last `suspend`), browser gone (last ping), idle timeout `LRS_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES` (30), re-login (previous session closed first). Sweeper in `server.py`. `suspend`/`resume`/`ping` beacons from `AuthProvider.tsx` (`apiBeacon`), reported only on the transition. Activity on an exited session reopens a new one from `auth/dependencies.py` (`effective_sid`) with its own `enter`; the cookie is re-minted by `/me`, `/session/resume`, `/session/ping`. |
| 2 | **Dashboard** ✅ | `{d}/dashboard/{type}` | `viewed` (+`result.duration`, always) | Filed on leave, once per visible stretch, through `hooks/useViewedDuration.ts` (POST on unmount, beacon on hide/pagehide): `student-personal` (learner's own board, `POST /api/brain/{id}/dashboard-viewed`), `student-view` (a teacher on a student's board — never `student-personal`), `learning-group` (home, learnings, learning detail: `POST /api/teacher/groups/{g}/dashboard-viewed`), `realtime-dashboard` (live students page: `POST /api/teacher/live/viewed` with `duration_seconds`). `dashboardId`: student types → the student's exidentifier; group types → the class NMM (`groups.nmm_id`, or the group id when the ministry provisioned it), never the school, never empty. No report on any GET. |
| 3 | **Agency questionnaire** (onboarding) ✅ | `{d}/agency/{PRE\|POST}` type `questionnaire` | `initialized`, `answered` (per question: `result.response` + `score{min,max,raw}`, parent = questionnaire), `completed` (+`completion`, duration) | onboarding = mapping → results span (`routes/learner_state.py`, `/api/submit`); duration = results-approved − `agency_started_at`. No POST questionnaire exists. |
| 4 | **Conversation (bot)** ✅ | `{d}/conversation/{id}` — **`{thread}--{itemId}`**: a new id per conversation *and* per item (spec: "conversationId חדש עבור שיחה חדשה או פריט שונה") | `interacted` (one per turn), `rated` (`result.response` like/dislike, same per-item id) | `reporter.report_conversation_interacted(component_id=<catalog slug>)` resolves the item from the brain, builds `componentId`/`itemId` as IRIs and the content ancestry (+ vendor). Student turn + bot turn in `coach/stream`; a typed hint = two `helpType=hint` turns (the `requested` rides the reservation); a support button's reply = bot turn (`hint`/`explanation`/`explanation` for a video summary/`alternative-content` for the visual); proactive nudges = bot turn, trigger mapped (idle→`idle-time`, error→`student-error`, success→`success-effort`), `helpType=bot-help-offer`; the mentoring writing helper = a conversation outside content (`content=False`, no ids, no ancestry). **Chat text is never sent.** |
| 5 | **Reflection questionnaire** ✅ | `{d}/reflection/{qid}` type `questionnaire` | `initialized` (`reflectionTrigger` **derived**: `end-of-learning-objective` when the component closed its objective, `difficult-task` on repeated wrong answers / a misconception / help asked, else `end-of-learning-component`), `answered` (response XOR score), `skipped`, `completed` (+duration) | `services/reflection_flow.py`; `ReflectionPanel` dismisses an open flow on unmount (`POST …/dismiss`): every open question `skipped`, then `completed` with `completion: false`. |
| 6 | **Mentor-student meeting** ✅ | `{d}/mentor-student-meeting/{id}` | `completed` (mentor/student/meetingDate/`mentoringPhase` — required, `phase1` for a record without one) | **Teacher-recorded talks only** (`mentoring_conversations.author == "teacher"`, `kind != "goal-assignment"`); the teacher composer requires the ladder step. A learner's own write-up reports its goals, not a meeting (not supported for now). |
| 7 | **Student goal** ✅ | `{d}/student-goal/{id}` (`definition.extensions/goalType` = `goal_progress.goal_type_for`: explicit type → action kind → activeness domain → `academic`) | `initialized` (creation, incl. a teacher assigning from the roster — with `context.instructor`), `updated` (progress moved, goal edited), `completed` (summarized; teacher approval with instructor) | `routes/mentoring.py`, `routes/brain.py`, `teacher_students.py`, `reporter.report_mentoring_record` |
| 8 | **Help request** ✅ | the **item** the learner is on (else the component) | `requested` (`helpSource=platform`, `helpType` hint\|explanation, + questionId when on a question) | hint/explanation buttons and typed hints → `coach_support.reserve_support`; video summary / visual retelling → `requested` on the video item (`explanation`) in `routes/agent.py` |
| 9 | **Selection (non-learning)** ✅ | the component/item | `selected` — `context.extensions/selectionType` ∈ `learning-type, practice-decision, is-understood, is-repeat, external-learning` (the PDF's tokens), value in `result.response` | platform: the completion dialog's more-practice/continue = `practice-decision` `true`/`false` (`/api/learning/path-choice`); the "different way" explainer = `learning-type` / `presentation`. Content-origin choices forwarded with the same enum (`events._content_report_fields`). |

## Content events — received from Kata, enriched + forwarded ✅

Arrive at `/api/xapi/{launch}/statements` (Kata relay) → `events.ingest_statement` (first sight only) → `_forward_to_moe_lrs` → `enriched_content_statement`: actor swapped to exidentifier, envelope merged (lms/session/program + `…/ecat/content-vendor/{10|521|310}` from the catalog's `manufacturer`), content's verb/object/result preserved, **all three levels of catalog metadata** as extensions (unit → component → item, `lrs/hierarchy.py`), the deepest grouping entry = the object, `parent` = the direct container. NEW outbound id. Ledger `source="kata"`.

Kata's ids are URLs since 09/2026 (`https://lomdot.education.gov.il/…/methodica-…-01-01`); Yuvi keys everything by the slug (`kata_client.content_slug`) and keeps the URL as `launch_id` for the launcher — see `kata-and-directions.md`.

| # | Family | Verbs |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | **Component** | `initialized`, `completed` (`result.success`, `score.scaled`, `duration`), `skipped` (component level — the platform's skip button, `/api/learning/skip-component`) |
| 11 | **Item: questionnaire** | `initialized`, `completed` (score + duration) |
| 12 | **Question** | `answered` (response/success/score; extensions questionId/questionType/attemptNumber; nested under its screen) |
| 13 | **Help (content)** | `requested` — `helpSource=content`, `helpType` = the content's declared kind if on the list else `hint`; nested under its question when asked on one |
| 14 | **Media** | `played`/`paused`/`completed` on a **`video`/`audio`/`animation` object** (never `item` — the media type outranks Kata's declaration); extensions mediaFormat/mediaPosition; `result.duration` on paused/completed. `mediaDuration` was removed in v1.1. |

## Known open points (not ours to invent)
- Kata sends `initialized` per screen, never per question; the ministry's "answered needs an initialize on the same object" rule can only be met by the content provider.
- Content played while the tab is hidden (a video running on) can land between `suspend` and `resume`.
